question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"epic."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Epic" **means grand or heroic, which is the most appropriate word to fill the blank. (बहुत लंबा और उत्तेजना भरा) • **Example**: *This is an **epic**__ story.* • **"Epic" **is the correct answer because it accurately conveys the intended meaning of the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 4. • **Correct passage:** At the core of the __**epic**__ lies the fierce ______ (2) ______ between two branches of the Kuru dynasty, the Pandavas and the Kauravas. The lifelong struggle ______ (3) ______ the cousins for the throne of Hastinapur Culminates ______ (4) ______ bloody battle of Kurukshetra, in which ______ (5) ______ kings of that period participated and perished. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Bright"** is an adjective that describes something that is shining or colorful. (प्रकाश-भरा, प्रदीप्‍त, उज्ज्वल, चमकीला) • **"Exercise"** is a noun that refers to physical activity done to improve health or fitness. ((शरीर के) स्वस्थ एवं मज़बूत बनाने के लिए किया गया शारीरिक तथा मानसिक क्रियाकलाप; व्‍यायाम, कसरत) • **"Dull"** is an adjective that describes something that is boring or uninteresting. (अरुचिकर या अनुत्तेजक; उबाऊ) 44:Td7c, The correct answer is **"rivalry."**
